title: Introduction - Main experiment preparation
body_text:
You are now entering the preparation phase for the Main experiment, which is the last phase of the Introduction. You are about to perform 2 tasks of 7 questions each. These tasks closely resemble those in the main experimental phase and are intended to help you practice and prepare for the main task.

As in the main experimental phase, you will have a limited amount of time to respond to each question. The allotted time for each question of this training task is 45 seconds, and it will be shorter for the evaluated tasks in the main experiment.

As this is still a training phase, your answers will not be recorded and your score will not count towards your bonus remuneration.

Please note that this is another opportunity to carefully analyze the AI’s outputs, as there will be less time for such analysis during the main experiment.
